title: This might be the most dexterous robotic hand ✋👀 #tech #ai #robot #trendingshorts
description:
Genesis AI, a Paris-based robotics startup, has unveiled GENE-26.5, a foundation model the company claims gives robots human-level manipulation.

Unlike robots programmed for single tasks, GENE-26.5 uses one AI brain to perform diverse skills: cooking a 20-step meal, pipetting in a lab, solving a Rubik's Cube two-handed, harnessing wires, and playing piano.

Central to the system is a sensor glove that records human hand motion and transfers it directly to a human-sized robotic hand, letting the model learn from demonstrations rather than explicit programming.

With $105 million in backing from investors including former Google CEO Eric Schmidt, the company is betting that the future of robotics lies in capturing the skills of human hands.
